notes:
2026-07-20: Created from scratch, merging all 29 rows from the founder-provided 'welding_metal_fabrication_resources.csv' (Section I.5) — this file had no prior entries. Four of the CSV's 10 channels could not be used as-cited: 'WeldingWeb TV' (no dedicated YouTube channel found for the forum brand — its forum itself was kept as this file's Forum blog entry), 'Chucke2009' (excluded — multiple independent welding-community forum threads report the channel turned to offensive/inflammatory non-welding content in recent years), 'Kenya Jua Kali Sector' (no channel by this name found — only scattered individual news-outlet videos about the sector), and 'Scratch Build Weld' (no matching channel found). 'Metalshaper (Ron Fournier)' was also corrected: the real @metalshaper-style channel belongs to a different creator (Brian, Willys Jeep restorations), not metal-shaping pioneer Ron Fournier, who passed away in 2017. Four independently-verified, directly on-topic replacements were substituted to reach 10 channels: Weld.com, The Fab Forums (Kyle Voss), Ron Covell, and 6061.com. Every real YouTube channel ID was independently looked up via search and channel-page fetches — the CSV's RSS_Feed column universally used a literal 'UC...' placeholder rather than real channel IDs.

Books audit (2026-07-30): All 10 book URLs audited. 9 of 10 had broken, unconfirmed, or piracy-site URLs. Fixes: (1) markupandprofit.com/resources subpage not in search index → /blog/ (confirmed active with free articles). (2) archive.org/howmuchshouldicharge unconfirmed → replaced with official author site ellenrohr.com/howmuch/ (FREE full ebook confirmed). (3) archive.org/traction-gino-wickman unconfirmed → eosworldwide.com/traction-book-free-chapter (official free chapter, confirmed April 2026). (4) bdebooks.com piracy site → theleanstartup.com (same fix as skill_03). (5) archive.org/RichDadPoorDad unconfirmed → confirmed copy (same fix as skill_03). (6) f5fp.com broken → archive.org E-Myth (same fix as skill_01–04). (7) mikemichalowicz.com broken → archive.org Profit First (same fix). (8) openstax small-business-management 404 → principles-management (same fix as skill_02–04). (9) archive.org/the-7-habits-of-highly-effective-people unconfirmed → confirmed copy with full chapter listing. (10) archive.org/personal-mba unconfirmed → confirmed copy (402 pages, Jan 2020 upload).
